SupaSaturday Ride: Moore Park to Ramsgate

Sydney, Australia · Kensington · Social

SupaSaturday Ride: Moore Park to Ramsgate is a social group ride in Sydney, Australia. It rolls every Saturday at 7:30 am local time from Dacey Avenue bus shelter, in front of the E S Marks Athletic Field.

For visitors

RSVP on Meetup. Mostly cycleways and back streets, with a short stretch on Dacey Ave and South Dowling St. BIKEast calls these recreational rides, not roadie-style group rides.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: medium, about 20 km/h average on Meetup; BIKEast's own page calls it fast.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the SupaSaturday Ride: Moore Park to Ramsgate group ride

A Saturday ride south through Waterloo, Mascot and around Sydney Airport, then along the cycle path through the Barton and Scarborough Park wetlands to Ramsgate Beach for coffee and pastries. BIKEast says the Saturday rides started in the late 1970s and the Ramsgate route in 2003.
